_readme: Built-in Thai public holidays, used when the phone's holiday calendar is unavailable. Compiled by hand (not downloaded from an official source) - verify against the official Bank of Thailand / cabinet list and refresh once a year (see README). Entries marked provisional are lunar-calendar or substitute-day estimates. One-off cabinet-announced holidays are NOT listed.
